Name: Uzziel, Son of Heman
Summary: Son of Heman the king's seer, named among his sons for song.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 25:4: Son of Heman the king's seer, named among his sons for song.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Uzziel stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
